label: sdc01_0040_student1_01
text: We’re finally here!

label: sdc01_0040_student2_01
text: My butt is killing me after all those hours sitting.\nFirst the plane, then that bus—!

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_01
text: Hahaha! Well, you all survived the long trip![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_02
text: And we haven’t lost anyone along the way?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_students_01
text: All here!

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_03
text: Then welcome to the land of Kitakami![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_04
text: This is the stage for all the new experiences and\nlearning opportunities you’ll have out in nature![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_05
text: It’s actually my first time here too. Why, the rice\nfields really are just dazzling![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_06
text: Up ahead is Mossui Town. That will be our base\nof operations for the duration of the trip![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_student3_01
text: M-Ms. Briar... I don’t feel so good...

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_07
text: Uh-oh! All that travel must have given you a dose\nof motion sickness, hm?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_08
text: Why don’t we pause here for a moment and take\nin the sight of these fields?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_09
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Now, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]... I have a little\nrequest\r\nfor you.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_10
text: Could you run ahead to the community center in\nMossui and let the caretaker know we’re here?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_11
text: It would also be great if you could explain that\none of our students is feeling unwell.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_select_01
text: I can do that

label: sdc01_0040_select_02
text: I’m on it!

label: sdc01_0040_bbteacher_12
text: I knew I’d be able to count on you.\c\nOn your way, then! I’ll look after your poor travel\nbuddy here.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0040_student1_02
text: This is my first time in another region! It even\nSMELLS different here!

label: sdc01_0040_student2_02
text: Do you think he’s all right? That was one bumpy\nbus ride.

label: sdc01_0040_student3_02
text: Ugh... My head... So this is how Psyduck\nmust feel...
